Subject: Vendor onboarding docs — W-8BEN-E + authorization

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick onboarding guidance earlier. Attached are our initial onboarding docs: a completed W-8BEN-E signed by our CFO, our Articles of Incorporation (Ireland), and a scanned copy of a corporate authorization that names Eva Byrne as the accounts signatory.

Files attached: W8BEN-E_LumenWorks_signed.pdf; Articles_of_Incorporation_Ireland.pdf; Notarized_Authorization_Eva_Byrne.pdf

- LumenWorks is a Dublin-registered company, no US EIN.
- We indicated treaty benefits on the W-8BEN-E; happy to provide any extra evidence.

Please confirm what else you need to move the PO through — we want to avoid delays on the first invoice.

Best,

procurement@lumenworks.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding docs — W-8BEN-E + authorization

Hi Eva — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround.

A few items before Finance can issue the PO:
1) Notarized signatory confirmation or corporate resolution naming the accounts payable contact (we received the authorization but need the notarized page to satisfy our vendor policy).
2) Since you selected treaty benefits on the W-8BEN-E, Finance needs a brief statement confirming the treaty residency (one paragraph is fine) and any supporting local tax registration if available.
3) Bank instructions for ACH (we prefer a proof of bank letter or a voided cheque). If you prefer wire, include bank SWIFT/IBAN + beneficiary details.

If the items above are provided by EOD Friday (PT), we can target PO issuance by Wednesday next week. If any of the items require legal notarization turnaround, flag and we can consider a conditional PO (PO issued but payment hold until verification).

I'll loop in finance — Priyom will confirm the exact docs needed for payment setup.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding docs — W-8BEN-E + authorization

Eva / Vivek — quick note from finance:

We need either (A) a notarized corporate resolution specifying Eva Byrne as authorized to sign on behalf of LumenWorks for invoicing and bank setup, or (B) an on-company-letterhead email from the CFO plus a notarized ID for the signatory. The notarized authorization you sent looks good but the stamp on page 3 is faint — can you resend a clearer scan or a DocuSign envelope with an ID verification step?

Also, for tax processing: because you indicated treaty benefits, please provide the local tax registration number (Irish CRO number is fine) so we can map the vendor classification in our AP system.

One more practical ask: send redacted bank account confirmation now for setup (we only need account number masked like ****1234 for the initial vendor record). Final bank docs can be provided once the PO is active.

If you hit any delays, tell us and we'll consider issuing a conditional PO (marked: payment contingent on final verification).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Finance Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Eva — thanks for the quick follow-up and the clearer scans. Priyom confirmed we have sufficient documentation for vendor record creation.

Planned next steps:
- 2026-09-02 (Wed): Finance will issue PO #PO-2026-4598 to invoices@lumenworks.com (net 30).
- After PO issuance: LumenWorks to provide final bank onboarding via our secure portal (we will send a link to the email on file).
- Payment hold policy: the PO will be issued normally; payments will clear once final bank verification completes (this is standard for cross-border vendors).

Action items for you: send the DocuSign envelope ID to invoices@lumenworks.com when ready (you already provided ABC12345 — thanks). If there are any certificate-of-residency documents from Irish tax authorities, please upload them to the Drive folder above; that will expedite tax classification.

If anything changes on your side, ping me directly — otherwise we'll proceed with the PO on Wednesday.

Thanks again and welcome aboard.
